description: Source and license of every asset. Each entry applies to the files matched by pathGlob (java.nio glob, relative to the repository root, e.g. 'assets/tiles/**'). When several entries match, the LAST one wins. Required fields: pathGlob, source, license, author, redistributable (boolean). Optional: status (placeholder | wip | final | generated | local-import). Bundled files (under assets/) must match an entry with redistributable=true; see docs/ASSET_IMPORT.md.
